The '''Vosteltig system''' was located in the [[Oplovis sector/Legends|Oplovis sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="New Territories" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] maintained the [[Vosteltig ship yards]]<ref name="WbC" /> in the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /> The [[Sluissi]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Ten Dorne]], who had deserted from the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior, was stationed there.<ref name="WbC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vosteltig system was introduced in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-5.<ref name="EAOC" />
